title: What if I do not crack NEET (or miss Govt MBBS cutoff)?
description: 24+ lakh students compete for ~55,000 Govt MBBS seats. Private colleges demand ₹80L-₹1.2Cr, which leads to crippling debt. This scenario simulates high-growth alternative pivots.

pivotOptions.newStreamOrDegree: B.Tech / B.Sc in Bioinformatics & AI in Healthcare
pivotOptions.rationale: Leverages biology enthusiasm with tech skills. Avoids repeat drop years and prevents ₹80L+ private medical debt.
Directly accessible via state CET without repeating NEET. Strong career progression in global pharma.

pivotOptions.pathwayName: Pivot to Clinical Psychology & Cognitive Science
pivotOptions.rationale: Deeply fulfilling clinical work without NEET entrance barrier. High growth in corporate mental health and digital UX.

title: What if I do not clear JEE Advanced for IIT?
description: Over 14 lakh candidates take JEE Main for only ~17,000 IIT seats. Failing JEE Advanced is NOT the end of tech careers.

pivotOptions.pathwayName: Top State Autonomous Route (e.g. COEP / VJTI via MHT-CET)
pivotOptions.entranceReq: MHT-CET (98+ percentile, much higher success rate than JEE Adv)
pivotOptions.rationale: COEP and top state autonomous colleges provide on-par median salaries to middle-tier NITs at 50% lower tuition fees.

pivotOptions.pathwayName: BCA + Top MCA (NIMCET Route to NITs)
pivotOptions.newStreamOrDegree: BCA (3 Years) ➔ MCA at NITs via NIMCET
pivotOptions.entranceReq: CUET / Direct Merit for BCA, NIMCET for MCA
pivotOptions.rationale: Circumvents intense 12th JEE pressure completely. NIMCET has 1/10th the applicant volume of JEE.

pivotOptions.newStreamOrDegree: BS in Data Science (IIT Madras Hybrid) + Local College
pivotOptions.entranceReq: Qualifier Test (Not rank-based, anyone scoring >50% passes)
pivotOptions.rationale: Open entry benchmarked by performance rather than cut-throat single-day entrance competition.

title: What if our family annual education budget drops by 50%?
description: Simulates unexpected economic shock, job loss, or medical emergencies, eliminating reliance on private college loans.

pivotOptions.pathwayName: Polytechnic Diploma ➔ Direct Second Year (DSE) State B.Tech
pivotOptions.newStreamOrDegree: Govt Polytechnic (3 yrs) + Direct 2nd Year Govt B.Tech (3 yrs)
pivotOptions.riskChange: High Debt Risk ➔ Zero Debt Risk
pivotOptions.rationale: Cuts education cost by over 75% while achieving the exact same B.Tech degree from a state university with zero bank loans.

pivotOptions.newStreamOrDegree: B.Sc Computer Science / IT at Govt Autonomous College
pivotOptions.riskChange: High Debt Risk ➔ Zero Debt Risk
pivotOptions.rationale: Enables first earning 1 year earlier. Pair low-cost college with open-source github portfolios and cloud certifications.

title: What if I study in Germany/Public European University vs Indian Private College?
description: Contrasting Indian private engineering (₹18-25L tuition) against German public university (Tuition €0, world-class lab infrastructure).

pivotOptions.pathwayName: TU Munich / RWTH Aachen Public Tech Route (Germany)
pivotOptions.newStreamOrDegree: B.Sc Mechanical / Information Engineering in Germany
pivotOptions.entranceReq: Studienkolleg T-Course / 1st Year India B.Tech + Goethe B2/C1
pivotOptions.riskChange: Moderate Risk ➔ High Initial Living Expense, but 3x Starting Salary
pivotOptions.rationale: Tuition is free in most German federal states. Expenses are solely living costs (~€934/month blocked account). Starting salaries are €55,000 (~₹48-52 LPA) with 18-month job seeker visa.
